patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: Started as a head cold off my grandson, and now I'm on that inhaler every hour and it's doing nothing at all. My test said it wasn't COVID.
presentation.triageNote: 71-year-old male with COPD, four days of coryza and now worsening breathlessness and wheeze unresponsive to his own inhaler.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because worsening COPD symptoms unresponsive to home inhaler with respiratory rate 26 and oxygen saturation 90% are high risk for respiratory deterioration.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This older adult with chronic lung disease has worsening dyspnea and wheeze after a viral prodrome, with poor rescue-inhaler response.
clinical.acuityReason: Borderline hypoxemia, tachypnea, and treatment failure require rapid bronchodilator and respiratory assessment rather than routine multi-resource sorting.
expectedResources: Controlled oxygen and immediate bronchodilator treatment
Chest imaging, ECG, and laboratory testing
Antibiotics when sputum or imaging supports them
redFlags: Poor treatment response with abnormal oxygenation
teachingPoints: Oxygen should be titrated appropriately rather than withheld from a hypoxemic patient.
Fatigue, confusion, reduced air movement, or worsening gas exchange would indicate impending failure.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Rapid respiratory treatment and reassessment would likely lead to observation or admission unless the patient returns safely to baseline.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 71-year-old man in a zip-up cardigan, seated on a blue padded clinic chair with an inhaler in his hand
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting leaning forward with elbows on his knees, shoulders hitched up with each breath
signs: an inhaler gripped in one hand
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: clearly short of breath but still talking in sentences
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 71-year-old man in a zip-up cardigan, seated on a blue padded clinic chair with an inhaler in his hand. Pose: sitting leaning forward with elbows on his knees, shoulders hitched up with each breath. Expression: tired and frustrated, jaw set. Clearly visible: pursed-lip breathing; raised hunched shoulders; an inhaler gripped in one hand. Overall: clearly short of breath but still talking in sentences. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
